defs.def: the whole of space and everything in it, including the earth, the planets and the stars 宇宙；天地万物；万象

ex.s: The 18th-century philosopher Kant argued that the universe ultimately consists of things-in-themselves that are unknowable.
ex.t: 18世纪哲学家康德认为,宇宙最终是由不可知的事物组成.

ex.s: So, if we accept that the universe is unknowable, we also accept we will never know if we live in a computer simulation.
ex.t: 因此,如果我们接受宇宙是不可知的,我们也接受我们永远不会知道我们是否生活在计算机模拟中.

ex.s: In Newton’s era, we imagined the universe as a clock.
ex.t: 在牛顿时代,我们把宇宙想象成时钟.

ex.s: Unsurprisingly, these new concepts inspire us to build new models of the universe.
ex.t: 毫不奇怪,这些新概念激励我们建立宇宙的新模式.

ex.s: C stop arguing whether the universe is a simulation
ex.t: C不再争论宇宙是不是模拟

ex.s: turn simulations of the universe into realities up.
But even this dismissal suggests something：perhaps, just like life itself throughout the universe, the rise of ALife will prove unavoidable.
ex.t: 但即使这次解雇也暗示了一件事:也许,就像整个宇宙的生命本身一样,丽丽芙的崛起将证明是不可避免的.

ex.s: Familiar examples include Earth as the center of the universe and the stability of continents.
ex.t: 更熟悉的例子包括地球作为宇宙的中心和大陆的稳定.

ex.s: The universe is all yours to explore and enjoy.
ex.t: 宇宙由你来探索和享受

ex.s: Using such techniques, the opera had transformed a small stage into the whole universe.
ex.t: 利用这些技术,歌剧将一个小舞台变成了整个宇宙.

ex.s: The only true voyage of discovery would be not to visit strange lands but to possess other eyes, to look at the universe through the eyes of another person, or of a hundred other people, to see the hundred universes that each of them sees.
ex.t: 唯一真正的探索之旅 不是去探寻陌生的土地 而是拥有其他的眼睛 透过另一个人或另外一百个人的眼睛 来观察宇宙

ex.s: So much of the universe remains unexplored that we are still close to the start of this incredible journey of discovery.
ex.t: 宇宙中很多东西还没有被探索出来,以至于我们仍接近于这个不可思议的发现之旅的开始.

ex.s: 6．（1分）The                 that there is life on other planets in the universe has always inspired scientists to explore the outer space．（  ）
ex.t: 6.(1cars)宇宙中其他行星存在生命,这一直激励着科学家探索外层空间. (.)

ex.s: There is no point in arguing if the universe is a clock, a set of particles or an output of computation.
ex.t: 争论宇宙是时钟,一组粒子还是计算输出是没有意义的.

defs.def: a system of stars, planets, etc. in space outside our own （已知宇宙以外的）宇宙

ex.s: And then, we can shift our inquiry from “Is the universe a computer simulation? ” to “Can we model the universe as a computer simulation? ” Modelling reality is what we do.
ex.t: 然后,我们可以把我们的询问从“宇宙是计算机模拟吗?”转移到“我们能够把宇宙模拟成计算机模拟吗?”

ex.s: We begin to see the interconnectedness of one thing to another in all aspects of our life, of ourselves and the universe.
ex.t: 我们开始看到,在我们生活、我们自己和宇宙的各个方面,一个事物与另一个事物相互关联。

ex.s: This vast dish also has the ability to explore regions of space billions of light years away, right at the edge of the visible universe.
ex.t: 这个巨大的菜肴还能够探索数十亿光年外的空间区域, 就在可见宇宙的边缘.

ex.s: Using ever-larger radio telescopes as our eyes, we will one day be able to look back to a time in the very early universe, before the existence of light.
ex.t: 利用更大的射电望远镜作为我们的眼睛, 有一天,我们将能够回顾早期的宇宙, 在光的存在之前。
